lines.latin: vulytsia Heroiv Ukrainy (Street of the Heroes of Ukraine)

notes: Two street-name plates on a post in a snowy Vilnius street, small in the frame (centre). Upper plate Lithuanian with 'Ų'; lower plate Ukrainian in a decorative Old-Slavonic-style typeface beside the Ukrainian trident arms. 'g.' abbreviates gatvė. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Ukrainian Heroes Street in Vilnius, the street sign.jpg

author: mikrimas
attribution: Photo: mikrimas, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Old_house_in_Vytauto_str._-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green 'bitė' mobile-operator shop sign over the door of a 1910 corner building, Vytauto g., Ukmergė; lower case with ė. House number '6' on the pilaster. Distractors: blue direction sign '174 RAGUVA / A6 E262 JONAVA KAUNAS / UTENA A6 E262', a 'TORTAI' sign at the far left, promo posters in the windows. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Old house in Vytauto str. - panoramio.jpg

author: Vilensija
attribution: Photo: Vilensija, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Senukai._Biuras_Kaune.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Gold serif 'SENUKAI' lettering under the black/red/yellow 'CSSD'-style chain logo on the corner of the Senukai head-office tower, Kaunas. Logo itself is a graphic, not text. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: mikrimas
attribution: Photo: mikrimas, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ba%C5%BEny%C4%8Dios_ir_Vytauto_g.sankirta_-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small white street plate with a double-headed arrow under a yield and pedestrian-crossing sign, right of centre, Ukmergė (corner of Bažnyčios and Vytauto g.). Distractor: green 'Drabužių' clothes-shop sign with a tiny illegible subtitle on the building opposite. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Ardfern
attribution: Photo: Ardfern, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A._Rotundo_Street,_Vilnius,_April_2015_(05).JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White enamel street plate on a grey wall in Vilnius, shot from below at a steep angle with slight motion blur. The plate has 'A.' and 'ROTUNDO' nearly touching; a space is given here.

author: Artrix
attribution: Photo: Artrix, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:McDonald%27s_sign_klaipeda.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Illuminated McDonald's sign with a 'McDRIVE 24 val.' panel at dusk, Klaipėda; image is somewhat soft. Left half is a Statoil pylon cut off at the edge ('...TATOIL' / '...ovykla'), a distractor.

author: Guillaume Speurt from Vilnius, Lithuania
attribution: Photo: Guillaume Speurt from Vilnius, Lithuania, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Store_in_Kaunas_in_2012.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Script fascia lettering of a bakery on Laisvės alėja, Kaunas; house-number plate '81' at the right. Distractors: 'biosala' projecting sign and green 'sala' lettering of the neighbouring shop, 'NATŪRALŪS LEDAI' poster in the window, round hanging sign at the right edge (illegible).
